title: Calibration and paired power of finite-grid absolute-difference statistics
status: The experimental design was fixed before simulation. Drivers require the exact protocol SHA256.
scope: Known independent null laws and explicitly generated disjoint-copy or partial-identity alternatives. No encryption-security claim, no new growing-window CLT, no general optimal-window assertion.

calibration.decision: Strict abs(S-mu)>z_(1-alpha/2)*sqrt(variance); equality is acceptance. Both rules use the same exact mean and same observed scores.
calibration.naive_variance: sum_e c_e Var(|D_i-D_j|), treating all nonnegative weighted pair occurrences as independent. This is not sum_e c_e^2 Var(h_e).
calibration.uncertainty: Pointwise95%Wilson intervals for each fixed-rule rejection probability; no simultaneous equivalence claim. alpha=.001 uses about20expected rejections forR20000 andabout5 for the256² R5000case, so it is exploratory.
calibration.diagnostics: Empirical mean/variance vs exact, standardized mean, variance ratio, normal quantiles, empirical CDFdistance. Known nonuniform and sparse laws are distinct specified nulls, not robustness under unknown misspecification.

power.discrepancy: Exact integer abs(denominator*raw_statistic-numerator) for Fraction null center; positive scaling does not alter ranks.
power.calibration: Independent null bank; independent continuous uniform tie variables for every statistic/sample. Reject above kth largest calibration lexicographic pair, k=alpha*(m+1), integer at both nominal levels.
power.bank_interpretation: Each rule has exact nominal marginal level over fresh banks/test observations. The fixed bank has a random conditional size; pointwise Wilson intervals assess that conditional size, and Beta(k,m+1-k) quantifies its across-bank variation. No exact equal realized-size assertion.
power.pairing: All statistics use the same fields within each model; fresh independent tie variables per statistic and shared across alpha levels preserve nested tests.
power.paired_intervals: At least95%pointwise conditional coverage by subtracting endpoints of two97.5%Clopper-Pearson intervals for the discordant probabilities. No simultaneouscoverage or universalpowerordering claim.
power.comparisons: Each S window versus NPCR and UACI; S_3x3,S_4x4,S_5x5 versus S_2x2. All contrasts are predefined.
power.copying: Each row partitioned into full blocks of2lag. Pair corresponding positions in the first/second halves; independent Bernoulli(theta) per pair replaces recipient difference by donor difference. Incomplete final block untouched. Equivalent difference distribution to copying both independent input-image intensities together.
power.partial_identity: Independently replace each difference by zero with probability epsilon; equivalent to setting the second input equal to the first at selected coordinates.
power.storage: Save raw integer statistics, calibration/test ties or their fixed seeds, thresholds and rejection counts. Archive source/protocol hashes.
power.seed_derivation: SeedSequence([master_seed,geometry_index,phase,stream]); phase0 calibration, phase1 independentnull, phase2+alternative_index for alternatives; stream0 field generation and alternative activation, stream1 tie uniforms. Each group has a tie array (sample_size,stat_count), reused across alpha levels.

analysis.finite_grid_sensitivity: Exact standardized mean shift for q2,256; grids64²,256²; lags1,2,3,4,6; widths2..12; theta=1/10. Bounded width search is descriptive and not poweroptimality.
analysis.statistical_progression: Moment correctness -> finite-grid Gaussian tail calibration -> randomized finite-sample rank calibration -> paired alternative power -> model-specific window sensitivity.
